e1.speaker: narrator
e1.text: At the end of the line hangs an eye made of broken mirrors. In every shard: a samurai in a straw hat. His hat. His stance. His blade. Yours.

e3.speaker: echo
e3.text: He found me in the ash of a burned village. Gave me a name. Sent me to three worlds. I said no at the last one. So he went and found another me.

e_both.speaker: echo
e_both.text: It's too late for me. He's already in my light - I can feel him pulling. Take it. And then don't give him yours.

e_fight.speaker: echo
e_fight.text: Show me the samurai I could have been.
